# 📋 Strike camp shower and sink

- **Checklist types:** Strike
- **Area:** Private infrastructure
- **When:** During Strike after campers stop using the shower and sink

## What you need

- Water Lead, Power Lead, and Build Lead
- 📦 Build Book — At the build station. Current camp-specific build and strike drawings, part counts, connection details, anchor locations, crew requirements, lift sequence, and final-state photographs for each structure.
- 🔧 Camp Shower — Shower area (see the map). Private shower for Treble Makers camp members only.
- 🔧 Camp Sink — Private infrastructure area (see the map). Camp sink connected to the fresh-water and gray-water systems.
- 🔧 Fresh Water Tank — Private infrastructure area. Camp tank containing potable water.
- 🔧 Gray-Water IBC — Private infrastructure area. Camp IBC that contains used kitchen and shower water.
- 🔧 Gray-Water Pump — Shower area. Pump that moves shower water into the camp gray-water system.
- 🔧 Potable Water Hose — Private infrastructure area. Camco TastePURE 25 ft drinking-water hose, 5/8 in inner diameter, lead- and BPA-free (22783).
- 📦 Build Hardware Bins — Build storage area. Bins containing structure-specific fittings, fasteners, anchors, chains, and small hardware.

## Ready before normal use

- **📦 Build Book:** The page for the current asset is complete and approved by the responsible lead.
- **🔧 Camp Shower:** The shower is open, clean, empty of personal belongings, and has no leak or standing water.
- **🔧 Camp Sink:** Potable water flows into the basin and drains into the gray-water system without leaking.
- **🔧 Fresh Water Tank:** The tank contains potable water and has no visible leak.
- **🔧 Gray-Water IBC:** The IBC has capacity for the task and has no visible leak.
- **🔧 Gray-Water Pump:** The pump is available and removes water from the shower basin.
- **🔧 Potable Water Hose:** The hose is used only for potable water and has no visible damage or dirt inside its fittings.

## Steps

1. Close the shower and sink to users.
2. Have the Water Lead isolate the potable-water supply.
3. Have the Water Lead move remaining line water into an approved fresh-water or gray-water container.
4. Run 🔧 Gray-Water Pump until the shower, sink, and connected gray-water lines are empty.
5. Have the Power Lead de-energize and disconnect the gray-water pump.
6. Disconnect and cap each water and gray-water line in the printed order.
7. Clean and dry the shower, sink, pump, and hoses.
8. Dismantle the shower and sink in the printed reverse sequence.
9. Put every fastener and small part in its assigned hardware bin.
10. Pack each dry component and capped hose in its assigned transport group.

## PASS when

- No fresh water or gray water was released onto the playa.
- The pump is de-energized and disconnected.
- Every shower, sink, pump, hose, fastener, and small part is clean, dry, accounted for, and packed.
- The former shower and sink footprints are clear and MOOP-free.

## Finish

- Before marking PASS, return each used item to its location and leave it ready for the next person.
- Collect all MOOP.
- If an item, instruction, or solution is missing or unclear, ask the Dominatrix.

### Leave items ready

- **📦 Build Book:** The book remains complete and at the build station.
- **🔧 Camp Shower:** No personal belonging, hair, trash, mud, visible dirt, leak, puddle, or standing water remains.
- **🔧 Camp Sink:** The basin and drain are clear, the water is off, and no water is leaking or pooled around the sink.
- **🔧 Fresh Water Tank:** The outlet is closed and no water is leaking or pooled around the tank.
- **🔧 Gray-Water IBC:** All inlets and outlets are closed when not in use. No gray water is leaking or pooled around the IBC.
- **🔧 Gray-Water Pump:** The pump is off after the shower basin is empty. No hose or connection leaks.
- **🔧 Potable Water Hose:** The hose is drained, coiled, and stored with both ends off the playa.
- **📦 Build Hardware Bins:** Hardware is sorted by asset, closed in its bin, and matches the count in 📦 Build Book.

### If an item is not ready

- **📦 Build Book:** Do not build, alter, or strike the affected asset. Tell the Build Lead.
- **🔧 Camp Shower:** Close the shower, display 🔧 Out of Service Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.
- **🔧 Camp Sink:** Stop using the sink and tell the Dominatrix.
- **🔧 Fresh Water Tank:** Stop using the tank and tell the Dominatrix. Do not let leaking water reach the playa.
- **🔧 Gray-Water IBC:** Stop showers, dishwashing, and other gray-water-producing tasks. Tell the Dominatrix. Do not let gray water reach the playa.
- **🔧 Gray-Water Pump:** Close the shower, display 🔧 Out of Service Sign, and tell the Dominatrix.
- **🔧 Potable Water Hose:** Do not use a garden or gray-water hose. Tell the Dominatrix.

## Who to ask

Water Lead
